name: image-project-scope
goal: Prevent a design image read from returning a previous project image after the selected project changes during asynchronous work

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: ProjectImageCacheService.read awaits catalog, cache and planning operations but relies on a project identity checked only at entry; identity() also obtains the current project after the first await. A direct read can outlive a session switch.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing registered image-reader method case covers ownership, corrupt cache, options and hashes while the selected project stays fixed. Strengthen the same case with controlled cache-hit and provider-free image-read delays across real session.open calls.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
